The staff was terrible. I was kicked out of the restroom because I was wearing a school uniform, even though I hadn't done anything wrong. Their tone and demeanor were awful. They just walked in without asking, and immediately told me to leave. I was very confused. The staff needs better training and there should be discussions about restroom usage. If they don't want students to use the restroom, they should put up a sign prohibiting students. There are many good students, and this staff member's generalization that all students are ill-behaved is making them look bad. I was very angry and disappointed today. I don't usually use this restroom, but today I needed to use it urgently, and this experience was unacceptable. Please consider this. They said that's just how they are, but their tone of voice was completely different from how they spoke to the manager. At first, I didn't mind, but when they said "you kicked me out," I got furious. If you're going to discriminate against students and say they're not customers, then put up a sign. I don't want good students who genuinely need to use the restroom to experience such inappropriate language and attitude.
